description: Pinned Android 14 VNDK v34 arm64 headers + link libraries for a non-stub (android-stub=false) Mesa Turnip using the HIDL mapper4 u_gralloc backend. Staged by stage-sysroot.py; every path is relative to the staged root. lib/ holds link-time inputs only: the device supplies these libraries at runtime.
url_encoding: ?format=TEXT urls return base64 of one file; +archive .tar.gz urls hold the file at 'member'. size and sha256 are of the file bytes.
